message.ar: المادتان 170 و185 من القانون التجاري: تطبق أحكام الإيجار التجاري على محلات الدولة والولايات والبلديات والمؤسسات العمومية التي تستوفي شروط النطاق، ولا يرفض تجديدها دون تعويض الإخلاء ولو للمنفعة العمومية؛ والمادة 800 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية تسند إلى المحاكم الإدارية القضايا التي تكون هذه الأشخاص طرفا فيها. تحقق من الجهة المختصة.
message.en: Commercial Code articles 170 and 185: the commercial-lease provisions apply to premises of the State, wilayas, communes and public bodies that meet the scope conditions, and their renewal cannot be refused without the eviction compensation, even for public utility; article 800 of the Code of civil and administrative procedure gives the administrative courts the cases to which these persons are party. Check the competent court.

question.ar: من أي تاريخ يطبق النظام الجديد: يوم نشر القانون المعدل في الجريدة الرسمية أم يوم نفاذه في كل جهة؟
question.en: From what date does the new regime apply: the day the amending law was published in the Official Journal, or the day it took effect in each place?

why.ar: المادة 187 مكرر تذكر تاريخ النشر ولا تحدده، والمخزن يؤرخ عدد الجريدة الرسمية الحامل للنص بـ9 فبراير 2005 في بيانات الصفحة لا في فقرة؛ والمادة 4 من القانون المدني تؤخر النفاذ خارج العاصمة إلى ما بعد وصول الجريدة إلى الدائرة، والمخزن يحمل ملاحظة بأن بدء السريان غير محسوم. حد العاشر من مارس 2005 في الحد n3 هامش عملي لا نص.
why.en: Article 187 مكرر names the publication date without giving it; the store dates the Official Journal issue carrying the text 9 February 2005 in its page data, not in a paragraph; Civil Code article 4 delays effect outside the capital until after the Journal reaches the daira, and the store notes that the start is unsettled. The 10 March 2005 bound of boundary n3 is a practical margin, not a text.

reading.ar: العبرة بتاريخ صدور عدد الجريدة الرسمية الذي نشر فيه القانون.
reading.en: The date of the Official Journal issue that published the law decides.

reading.ar: العبرة بتاريخ نفاذ القانون في مكان إبرام العقد.
reading.en: The date the law took effect where the lease was made decides.

protectiveReading.ar: تطبيق النظام السابق على العقود السابقة لتاريخ النشر، والتنبيه على العقود المبرمة في الأسابيع التالية له.
protectiveReading.en: Apply the old regime to leases made before the publication date, and warn on leases made in the weeks after it.

question.ar: ما جزاء عدم تبليغ التكليف بالحضور خلال ثلاثة أشهر من تبليغ رفض التجديد، وكيف تحسب المدة، وما علاقتها بمهلة الثلاثة أشهر في المادة 194 وبمهلة القبول في المادة 178؟
question.en: What is the sanction for not serving the summons within three months of the refusal to renew, how is the period counted, and how does it relate to the three months of article 194 and to the acceptance period of article 178?

why.ar: المادة 197 تفرض الأجل دون جزاء صريح ولا طريقة حساب، والمادة 194 تصوغ الثلاثة أشهر كمهلة يرفع بعدها النزاع، والمادة 178 تجعل للمستأجر ثلاثة أشهر للقبول وتحيل في الدعوى إلى شروط المادة 197.
why.en: Article 197 sets the period without an express sanction or counting rule, article 194 words the three months as a period after which the dispute is brought, and article 178 gives the lessee three months to accept and sends the suit to the conditions of article 197.

reading.ar: سقوط حق المستأجر في المنازعة وفي التعويض.
reading.en: The lessee loses the right to contest and to compensation.

reading.ar: أجل تنظيمي بلا جزاء.
reading.en: A directory period with no sanction.

reading.ar: المادة 194 عامة والمادة 197 خاصة برفض التجديد وتحكمه.
reading.en: The general article 194 gives way to the special article 197 on refusal.

protectiveReading.ar: تبليغ التكليف بالحضور داخل ثلاثة أشهر من تبليغ الرفض، والتحذير عند فوات الأجل أو اقترابه دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Serve the summons within three months of the refusal; warn when the period has run or is close, without blocking the export.

question.ar: من أي واقعة يسري تقادم السنتين، وهل يشمل دعوى الإخلاء بانتهاء الأجل في النظام الجديد، وهل يمدد إذا انتهى في يوم عطلة؟
question.en: From what event does the two-year limitation run, does it reach an eviction claim at the end of the term under the new regime, and does it run on when it ends on a holiday?

why.ar: المادة 198 لا تحدد بدء السريان ولا تفصل نطاق دعاوى الباب، ومسألة التمديد إلى يوم العمل قراءة محفوظة في وحدة الآجال.
why.en: Article 198 names neither the starting event nor the exact scope of the actions under the title; extension to the next working day is a reading kept in the periods module.

reading.ar: من نشوء الحق المطالب به.
reading.en: From the day the right claimed arose.

reading.ar: من يوم الاستحقاق وفق القاعدة العامة للتقادم.
reading.en: From the due date under the general limitation rule.

protectiveReading.ar: طلب تاريخ الواقعة والتحذير من أقرب تاريخ ممكن، دون منع.
protectiveReading.en: Ask for the date of the event and warn from the earliest plausible date, never block.

question.ar: هل يعد عقد جديد أبرم بعد نشر القانون المعدل بين نفس الطرفين على نفس المحل تجديدا لإيجار سابق يبقى خاضعا للتشريع القديم؟
question.en: Is a new lease signed after the amending law's publication between the same parties for the same premises a renewal of an earlier lease that stays under the old law?

why.ar: المادة 187 مكرر 1 تبقي تجديد العقود السابقة خاضعا للتشريع القديم ولا تعرف التجديد.
why.en: Article 187 مكرر 1 keeps the renewal of earlier leases under the old law and does not define renewal.

reading.ar: العبرة بتاريخ العقد الأصلي ما دام العقد الجديد تجديدا له.
reading.en: The original lease's date decides as long as the new deed renews it.

reading.ar: العقد الجديد المحرر رسميا بعد النشر يخضع للنظام الجديد.
reading.en: A new official deed made after publication falls under the new regime.

protectiveReading.ar: يطلب من المحامي تاريخ العقد الأصلي ويحذر من الخلاف.
protectiveReading.en: Ask the lawyer for the original lease's date and warn of the question.

question.ar: هل تطبق أحكام المادتين 177 و191 (الإنذار والإخطار بالدفع) على الإيجارات الخاضعة للمادة 187 مكرر؟
question.en: Do articles 177 and 191 (the warning and the demand for payment) apply to leases under article 187 مكرر?

why.ar: المادة 187 مكرر تستبعد التنبيه وتعويض الاستحقاق فقط ولا تتعرض لباقي الأحكام.
why.en: Article 187 مكرر excludes only the notice to quit and the eviction compensation and says nothing of the other provisions.

protectiveReading.ar: تطبيق المادة 191 على النظامين مع التحذير فقط.
protectiveReading.en: Apply article 191 to both regimes, with a warning only.

question.ar: ما حكم الإيجار المبرم بعد النشر في غير الشكل الرسمي، وما القواعد التي تحكم الشغل حينئذ؟
question.en: What becomes of a lease made after publication without the official form, and what rules then govern the occupation?

why.ar: المادة 187 مكرر تقرر البطلان ولا تبين آثاره.
why.en: Article 187 مكرر states nullity but not its effects.

protectiveReading.ar: التحذير ودعوة المحامي إلى التحقق من أساس طلباته.
protectiveReading.en: Warn and ask the lawyer to check the basis of the requests.

question.ar: هل يبقى للمستأجر في النظام الجديد حق في تجديد أو في تعويض إذا لم يشترط ذلك؟
question.en: Does a lessee under the new regime keep any right to renewal or compensation if none is stipulated?

why.ar: النص يقرر مغادرة الأمكنة بانتهاء الأجل دون تعويض ما لم يشترط خلاف ذلك، ولا يبين مصير حق التجديد الوارد في الباب.
why.en: The text says the lessee leaves at the term without compensation unless otherwise stipulated and does not say what becomes of the renewal rights in the title.

reading.ar: لا حق في التجديد ولا في التعويض إلا بالاشتراط.
reading.en: No right to renewal or compensation unless stipulated.

reading.ar: تبقى قواعد التجديد سارية في كل ما لم يستبعده النص صراحة.
reading.en: The renewal rules still apply where the text does not expressly exclude them.

protectiveReading.ar: سؤال المحامي عن الاشتراط والتحذير دون الجزم بزوال حق التجديد.
protectiveReading.en: Ask about any stipulation and warn, without asserting that the renewal right is gone.

question.ar: هل ينظر القسم التجاري أم القسم العقاري في نزاع الإيجار التجاري؟
question.en: Does the commercial or the real-estate section hear a commercial-premises lease dispute?

why.ar: المادة 512 تذكر السكنات والمحلات المهنية فقط والمادة 531 المنازعات التجارية، ولا يسمي أي نص القسم المختص بالإيجار التجاري.
why.en: The real-estate article names dwellings and professional premises only; the commercial article names commercial disputes; no text names the section for commercial leases.

reading.ar: القسم التجاري.
reading.en: Commercial section.

reading.ar: القسم العقاري.
reading.en: Real-estate section.

reading.ar: يترك تحديد القسم لوحدة أقسام المحكمة.
reading.en: The section is left to the court-sections module.

protectiveReading.ar: اقتراح القسم التجاري مع تحذير عند اختلاف القسم المختار.
protectiveReading.en: Propose the commercial section and warn if the lawyer's section differs.

question.ar: هل ما زالت إحالات المادة 195 وما يليها إلى قانون الإجراءات المدنية القديم وإلى المجلس الأعلى سارية، وما المقابل الحالي؟
question.en: Do the references of article 195 and following to the old code of civil procedure and to the Supreme Council still stand, and what is their current equivalent?

why.ar: المادة 195 تحيل إلى مواد من قانون إجراءات ملغى والمجلس الأعلى، والمرجع الحالي غير مذكور، والنص القديم ليس في المخزن.
why.en: Article 195 refers to articles of an earlier code of civil procedure and to the Supreme Council; the current equivalent is not named, and the old text is not in the store.

reading.ar: تطبق القواعد الحالية للاستعجال والاستئناف.
reading.en: The current rules on summary procedure and appeal apply.

protectiveReading.en: Follow the current rules and warn.

question.ar: ما حكم تأجير التسيير (المادة 203 وما يليها)؟
question.en: What governs a management lease of the business itself?

why.ar: النص غير موجود في مخزن المواد، وما هو معروف من الذاكرة أن تأجير التسيير له أحكامه الخاصة خارج هذا الباب.
why.en: The text is not in the article store; from memory a management lease has its own rules outside this title.

reading.ar: خارج نطاق الباب.
reading.en: Outside this title.

protectiveReading.en: A reader's note and a warning where suspected.

question.ar: ما الذي تضيفه العادات المحلية إلى أجل التنبيه بالإخلاء؟
question.en: What does local usage add to the notice period?

why.ar: المادة 173 تشترط ستة أشهر على الأقل مع مراعاة العادات المحلية، ولا تبين هذه العادات.
why.en: Article 173 requires at least six months and refers to local usage without stating it.

reading.ar: ستة أشهر حد أدنى وقد تزيد العادة.
reading.en: Six months is a floor and usage may lengthen it.

protectiveReading.ar: اعتماد ستة أشهر حدا أدنى وسؤال المحامي عن العادة.
protectiveReading.en: Take six months as a floor and ask the lawyer about usage.

question.ar: هل يمنع غياب التنبيه بالإخلاء أو بطلانه دعوى المؤجر بالإخلاء في إيجار خاضع للنظام السابق؟
question.en: Does a missing or void notice to quit bar the lessor's eviction claim under a lease of the pre-2005 regime?

why.ar: المادة 173 تجعل التنبيه شرطا لانتهاء الإيجار وتقرر بطلانه وتمديد الإيجار المكتوب ضمنيا، لكن المادة 174 تفتح طريق طلب التجديد ورفضه، والمادة 187 تبقي المستأجر المستحق للتعويض في الأمكنة إلى قبضه؛ فلا يحدد النص أثر الغياب على العريضة.
why.en: Article 173 makes the notice the condition of the lease's end, voids a defective one and extends a written lease tacitly, but article 174 opens the route of the lessee's renewal request and its refusal, and article 187 keeps a lessee owed compensation in place until paid; the text does not set what the absence does to the petition.

reading.ar: لا ينتهي الإيجار فلا تقبل دعوى الإخلاء بانتهاء الأجل.
reading.en: The lease has not ended, so an eviction claim at term fails.

reading.ar: قد ينتهي التجديد برفض طلب المستأجر، فيبقى الإخلاء ممكنا مقابل التعويض.
reading.en: The renewal may end through the refusal of the lessee's request, so eviction stays possible against the compensation.

protectiveReading.ar: التحذير عند غياب التنبيه أو بطلانه، وسؤال المحامي عند جهل حاله، دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Warn when the notice is missing or void and ask when it is unknown, without blocking the export.

question.ar: هل تختص المحكمة الإدارية بنزاع الإيجار التجاري إذا كانت الدولة أو الولاية أو البلدية أو مؤسسة عمومية ذات صبغة إدارية طرفا فيه، أم المحكمة العادية التي يقع بدائرتها العقار؟
question.en: Does the administrative court hear a commercial-lease dispute to which the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body is party, or the ordinary court where the building lies?

why.ar: المادة 800 من قانون الإجراءات المدنية والإدارية تعتمد صفة الطرف ولا تذكر المادة 802 الإيجار بين استثناءاتها، لكن الفقرة الأولى من المادة 800 تستثني المنازعات الموكلة إلى جهات أخرى، والمادتان 194 و197 من القانون التجاري ترفعان نزاعات الإيجار إلى المحكمة التي يقع بدائرتها العقار.
why.en: Article 800 of the Code of civil and administrative procedure turns on the party's status and article 802 lists no lease dispute among its exceptions, but article 800 ¶1 excepts disputes given to other courts, and Commercial Code articles 194 and 197 send lease disputes to the court where the building lies.

reading.ar: تختص المحكمة الإدارية بصفة الطرف العام.
reading.en: The administrative court, by the public party's status.

reading.ar: تختص المحكمة العادية لأن نصوص الإيجار التجاري تسند النزاع إلى محكمة موقع العمارة.
reading.en: The ordinary court, because the commercial-lease texts send the dispute to the court where the building lies.

protectiveReading.ar: التحذير من اختصاص المحكمة الإدارية متى كان أحد هذه الأشخاص طرفا، دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Warn that the administrative court may be competent whenever one of these persons is party, without blocking the export.

question.ar: هل يسقط حق المستأجر في تعويض الإخلاء ويصبح شاغلا بدون حق ولا سند إذا لم يبلغ التكليف بالحضور خلال ثلاثة أشهر من تبليغ التنبيه بالإخلاء أو رفض التجديد؟
question.en: Does a lessee who does not serve the summons within three months of the notice to quit or the refusal lose the eviction compensation and become an occupant without right or title?

why.ar: نسب الخصم هذه القراءة إلى اجتهاد مستقر للمحكمة العليا من الذاكرة، دون رقم قرار ولا تاريخ، ولم يعثر على نص القرار في موقع المحكمة العليا؛ والمادة 197 لا تذكر جزاء صريحا.
why.en: The adversary attributed this reading to a settled Supreme Court line from memory, with no decision number or date, and no such decision was found on the Supreme Court's site; article 197 states no express sanction.

reading.ar: أجل سقوط: بفواته يفقد المستأجر التعويض ويجوز إخلاؤه دون تعويض.
reading.en: A forfeiture: once it passes the lessee loses the compensation and may be evicted without it.

reading.ar: أجل بلا جزاء صريح في النص.
reading.en: A period with no express sanction in the text.

protectiveReading.ar: يحذر محامي المستأجر من فوات الأجل، ويسأل محامي المؤجر عن حق المستأجر في التعويض قبل اقتراح الإخلاء بعد قبضه.
protectiveReading.en: Warn the lessee's lawyer of the period; for the lessor, ask whether the lessee still has a right to compensation before proposing eviction after payment.

question.ar: هل يجوز للمالك الخاسر التملص من تعويض الإخلاء بقبول التجديد ما دام المستأجر في الأمكنة ولم يؤجر أو يشتر عمارة أخرى، أم يمتنع عليه ذلك في هذه الحالة؟
question.en: May the losing owner escape the eviction compensation by accepting renewal while the lessee is still in the premises and has not leased or bought another building, or is that exactly when he may not?

why.ar: الفقرة السابعة من المادة 197 بالعربية: «ولا يجوز ممارسة هذا الحق مادام المستأجر مازال موجودا في الاماكن وما دام لم يؤجر أو لم يشتر عمارة أخرى»، والنص الفرنسي للأمر نفسه في الجريدة الرسمية (1975، العدد 101، ص 1088): «Ce droit ne peut être exercé qu'autant que le locataire est encore dans les lieux et n'a pas déjà loué ou acheté un autre immeuble»، أي لا يمارس إلا في هذه الحالة.
why.en: Article 197 ¶7 in Arabic: «ولا يجوز ممارسة هذا الحق مادام المستأجر مازال موجودا في الاماكن وما دام لم يؤجر أو لم يشتر عمارة أخرى» (not while); the French text of the same ordinance in the Official Journal (1975 No. 101, p. 1088): «Ce droit ne peut être exercé qu'autant que le locataire est encore dans les lieux et n'a pas déjà loué ou acheté un autre immeuble» (only while).

reading.ar: حرفية النص العربي: لا يمارس المالك حق التملص ما دام المستأجر في الأمكنة ولم يؤجر أو يشتر عمارة أخرى.
reading.en: The Arabic wording: the owner may not use the right as long as the lessee is still in the premises and has not leased or bought another building.

reading.ar: النص الفرنسي: لا يمارس المالك حق التملص إلا ما دام المستأجر في الأمكنة ولم يؤجر أو يشتر عمارة أخرى.
reading.en: The French wording: the owner may use the right only while the lessee is still in the premises and has not leased or bought another building.

protectiveReading.ar: عرض القراءتين على المحامي دون أن يبنى عليهما أي تحذير أو منع؛ فلا يقطع محامي المستأجر بأن التعويض مكتسب ما دام موكله في الأمكنة، ولا يؤخر محامي المالك قبوله التجديد إلى ما بعد مغادرة المستأجر.
protectiveReading.en: Show both readings to the lawyer and build no warning or block on them: the lessee's lawyer should not count the compensation as secured while his client is still in the premises, and the owner's lawyer should not put off accepting the renewal until the lessee has left.

question.ar: إذا وجه المؤجر تنبيها بالإخلاء باطلا، هل كان على المستأجر أن يقدم طلب التجديد قبل أن ينازع في الرفض أو يطالب بتعويض الإخلاء؟
question.en: When the lessor served a void notice to quit, did the lessee have to make a renewal request before contesting the refusal or claiming the eviction compensation?

why.ar: المادة 173 تقرر بطلان التنبيه المعيب وتمديد الإيجار المكتوب ضمنيا عند عدم التنبيه، والمادة 174 تفرض طلب التجديد «فى حالة عدم التنبيه بالاخلاء»؛ لكن المادتين 175 و178 تجعلان التنبيه بالإخلاء إحدى طريقتي تبليغ رفض التجديد، والمادة 197 تفتح للمستأجر دعوى المنازعة في الرفض مباشرة؛ ولا يقول النص إن التنبيه الباطل يعد عدما.
why.en: Article 173 voids a defective notice and extends a written lease tacitly when there is no notice, and article 174 requires the renewal request «فى حالة عدم التنبيه بالاخلاء»; but articles 175 and 178 make the notice to quit one of the two ways the refusal is notified, and article 197 opens the lessee's action against the refusal directly; the text does not say that a void notice counts as no notice.

reading.ar: التنبيه الباطل كعدمه، فيلزم طلب التجديد وفق المادة 174.
reading.en: A void notice counts as no notice, so the renewal request of article 174 was needed.

reading.ar: التنبيه ولو كان معيبا يبلغ رفض المؤجر، فينازع فيه المستأجر مباشرة دون طلب تجديد.
reading.en: Even a defective notice notifies the lessor's refusal, which the lessee contests directly without a renewal request.

protectiveReading.ar: التحذير عند بطلان التنبيه وغياب طلب التجديد، دون منع التصدير.
protectiveReading.en: Warn when the notice is void and no renewal request was made, without blocking the export.

checklist.item: Is the lease a lease of premises in which a business (fonds de commerce / محل تجاري) is operated, so that the lease chapter of the Commercial Code (about articles 169 to 202) applies at all, rather than the Civil Code lease rules?
checklist.note: Commercial Code 169 ¶1 sets the scope; the slot commercial_lease gates every item.

checklist.item: Which premises and persons are covered by the chapter beyond shops: premises accessory to the business, bare land on which permanent buildings were put up, public bodies' premises, craftsmen registered in the crafts register, and which are excluded (public domain, short or seasonal occupation)?
checklist.note: No text on seasonal occupation in the chapter; the exclusions in the store are temporary permits (170 ¶5) and emphyteutic leases (171 ¶1).

checklist.item: On what date was the lease made, and was it made before or on/after the publication of Law 05-02 of 6 February 2005 amending the Commercial Code (published in the Official Journal in February 2005)? That date decides the regime.
checklist.note: The store dates the Official Journal issue (issue 11) 9 February 2005 in its page data; the record uses that date and warns in the weeks after it. Law 05-02's own articles are not in the store.

checklist.item: Under the post-2005 regime (article 187 bis as I remember it): must the lease be made in an official (notarial) form on pain of nullity, and is its term freely fixed by the parties?
Under the post-2005 regime: at the end of the agreed term, must the lessee leave without a notice to quit and without eviction compensation, unless the parties stipulated otherwise?

Transitional rule (article 187 bis 1 as I remember it): leases made before the publication stay governed by the law in force when they were made; is a renewal made after the publication governed by the new regime?
checklist.note: The store's text: the renewal of a pre-publication lease stays under the law in force when it was made.

checklist.item: Under the old regime: what condition gives the lessee a right to renewal: operating the same business for two consecutive years under a written lease, or four years under successive verbal leases (article 172 as I remember)?
Under the old regime: does a lease end only by a notice to quit (تنبيه بالإخلاء) given by the lessor, the lease otherwise continuing tacitly?

Notice to quit under the old regime: its form (an extrajudicial act served by a bailiff), its minimum period (at least six months before the date of leaving, following local usage), the obligatory statement of reasons, and the reproduction of the text giving the lessee the period to sue; is the sanction nullity?

Old regime: the lessee's own request for renewal: form, timing (in the last months of the lease or during its tacit extension), the lessor's duty to answer within a set period, and the effect of the lessor's silence (deemed acceptance)?

Old regime: the period within which the lessee who contests the notice to quit or claims the eviction compensation must bring the case before the court (three months from the notice as I remember), and the sanction (forfeiture of the right to renewal or compensation)?
checklist.note: Three months for serving the summons from the notification of the refusal; the text states no sanction, so the deadline is interpretive and warns.

checklist.item: Old regime: refusal of renewal: the lessor may refuse but must pay the eviction compensation (تعويض الاستحقاق) equal to the harm caused by the refusal; what the compensation includes (market value of the business, moving and reinstallation costs, transfer fees) unless the lessor proves a lesser harm?

Old regime: refusal of renewal without compensation: serious and legitimate reason against the lessee (failure to pay rent, breach of the lease) only after a formal notice that went unheeded for one month; building to be demolished as insalubrious or dangerous; and how these exceptions are proven.

Old regime: the lessor's right to take back for rebuilding, for personal or family residence, or the right to repent (حق الندم / droit de repentir) by agreeing to renew within a period after the judgment fixing the compensation.
Old regime: the lessee's right to stay in the premises until the eviction compensation is paid (right of retention), and the occupation indemnity he owes in the meantime.
Old regime: the length of the renewed lease (nine years unless agreed otherwise?) and revision of rent every three years?
checklist.note: Renewed lease equals the previous length, at most nine years unless agreed; revision after at least three years.

checklist.item: Limitation: is there a short limitation (two years?) for actions under the commercial-lease chapter, from what event, and is it raised only on a plea? (Counting and the plea come from the periods module.)
checklist.note: Two years, starting event not stated; counted under civil-code 314 ¶1 and 3 ¶1; raised only on a plea (civil-code 321 ¶1).

checklist.item: Is the lessee's right of renewal and the compensation rule of public order, so that clauses excluding it are void under the old regime (a clause nullity article near the end of the chapter)?
Assignment of the lease with the business and sublease: are clauses forbidding assignment to the buyer of the business void; is subletting forbidden unless agreed?
Rent revision procedure and the court competent for it (the president of the court?)

Who must prove what: the lessee proves the lease, its date and the period of operation; the lessor proves the serious and legitimate reason or the demolition ground; the date of the notice to quit is proved by the bailiff act.
checklist.note: General proof rules belong to the proof module.

checklist.item: Requests usually made: eviction of the lessee at term (post-2005) or after a valid notice (old regime); payment of rent arrears; eviction compensation; nullity of the notice to quit; renewal of the lease; occupation indemnity; damages; provisional execution (imported from accessory-requests).
checklist.note: Rent arrears, interest and provisional execution belong to the claim records and the accessory-requests module.

checklist.item: Facts to state: lease concluded (date, form), lease started, rent unpaid if relied on, eviction notice served (date, means, content), renewal refused, notice/formal notice served.

Competent section: the commercial section of the court (lessor and lessee merchants; commercial lease is a commercial act), or the civil/real-property section when the lessor is not a merchant? Import court-sections.
checklist.note: The record's court.section proposes the commercial section, interpretive (no text names the section); the court-sections module may override in the claim records.

checklist.item: Territorial jurisdiction: the court where the premises lie for leases of real property? Import territorial-jurisdiction.

Exits: does a commercial lease dispute go to the specialised commercial court (it is not in that court's list, so normally not); administrative court when the lessor is a public administrative body; summary judge (référé) for eviction of an occupant without title or for evident breach. Import ordinary-court-exits.
checklist.note: The chapter's own exit is the president of the court for renewal terms and rent revision; the specialised commercial court is left to the ordinary-court-exits module; x2 (cpca 800 ¶2) warns of the administrative court when the State, a wilaya, a commune or a public administrative body is a party, a reading kept in o13.

checklist.item: Formal notice before claiming rent or rescission for breach: import formal-notice; the one-month notice for a serious and legitimate reason is specific to the lease chapter.
checklist.note: The general formal notice is left to the formal-notice module.

checklist.item: Post-2005 lease not made in official form: is it null, and what then governs the occupation (Civil Code lease rules, occupation without title)?
Post-2005 lease whose term expired with the lessee staying in place: tacit renewal under the Civil Code, or occupation without title; and whether the parties' stipulation of compensation applies.
checklist.note: The chapter does not say what follows a lessee staying past the term under the new regime; only the stipulation exception is in the text.

checklist.item: Pre-2005 lease renewed after February 2005: does the renewal bring it under the new regime, and what counts as a renewal (express new lease, tacit continuation)?

Look-alikes that are not this claim: a residential lease or professional premises lease (Civil Code articles 467 and following, as amended by Law 07-05 in 2007); lease-management (location-gérance) of the business; sale of the business; lease of public domain premises (administrative contract).
checklist.note: Lease-management is mentioned only in 172 ¶2 (n12).

checklist.item: Civil Code amendments of 2007 (Law 07-05) on leases: notice period for leases under the Civil Code and written form; check whether they apply to commercial premises by reference.
checklist.note: No text in the store makes the Civil Code lease rules apply to commercial leases by reference.

checklist.item: Documents to attach: the lease (official deed for post-2005), the bailiff's notice to quit or the renewal request and the answer, the commercial register extract, rent receipts, a formal notice for breach.
Unknown contract date or unknown regime: the evaluator must ask for the contract date; if missing, warn rather than conclude on the regime.
Is the premises really a commercial lease (a business, trade or craft run in the leased premises) rather than a residential or professional lease or a simple occupation?
Is the lease in writing, and what is its date: the date of the contract decides which regime applies?
Was the contract made before or after the 2005 reform (Law 05-02), and what transitional rule applies to contracts in progress?
Under the old regime (1975 text): what protection did the tenant have, and what was the right to renewal?
checklist.note: Old-regime rules read from the articles in the 1975 wording as kept in the store; 187 مكرر 1 keeps them for pre-publication leases.

checklist.item: Under the reformed regime: is the lease freely agreed as to duration, and what is the effect of a fixed-term lease expiring?
Who is the landlord and who is the tenant; does the plaintiff have standing (owner, usufructuary, assignee)?
checklist.note: Standing and interest are in the petition-formal-elements module; the lease chapter adds only the transferee's position (b10).

checklist.item: Has a notice to quit (tanbih bil-ikhla) been served, and in what form (bailiff, writing)?
What notice period must be given by the landlord to end the lease, and from what date does it run?
What must the notice to quit contain (grounds, refusal of renewal, offer of compensation, reproduction of the tenant's right to challenge)?
What period does the tenant have to challenge the notice or to claim renewal, and what is the sanction of missing it?
Is the notice period calendar-counted, and how are the days counted?
checklist.note: d2 (a limitation) is counted under civil-code 314 ¶1 and 3 ¶1; no counting article in the store reaches the Commercial Code's three-month period of d1, which stays interpretive.

checklist.item: Can the landlord refuse renewal, on what grounds, and does refusal require paying eviction compensation?
How is the eviction compensation computed, and what does it cover (goodwill, moving, loss of clientele)?
Are there cases where refusal of renewal is without compensation (serious and legitimate grounds, tenant's default, demolition)?
Who must prove the tenant's default and the legitimacy of refusal?
Has the tenant paid the rent, and has a formal notice for unpaid rent been served first?
Is the claim for eviction, rescission, payment of rent, or validity of the notice, and which request kinds follow?
Which section of the court hears commercial lease disputes (commercial section, or real-estate section) and which court by place (location of the premises)?
Does the specialised commercial court take the dispute or the ordinary court?
checklist.note: The specialised commercial court is dealt with in ordinary-court-exits; no text on commercial leases sends them there.

checklist.item: Is the lessor a public body (State, wilaya, commune) so that the administrative courts or a special regime applies?
checklist.note: The lease chapter applies to public bodies' premises (170 ¶4) with 185 and 186; cpca 800 ¶2 gives the administrative courts the cases to which these persons are party and 802 lists no lease exception, so x2 warns (interpretive, o13); n15 states the substantive rule.

checklist.item: Is a conciliation or mediation step required before filing?
checklist.note: No step before filing is required of the lawyer in articles 169 to 202 (194 ¶1's three months are kept as a reading of d1, o2). Before the commercial section, cpca 534 ¶1-¶2 (Law 22-13, not deferred by its art. 13) makes the president refer the dispute to mediation first, without the parties' consent: a court step after filing, told in the section message (b69).

checklist.item: Is the property registered at the land registry and does the lease need publication?
checklist.note: No publication rule appears in the lease articles; see land-registry-publication.

checklist.item: Has the tenant sublet or assigned the lease, and is this allowed by the contract?
Is there a limitation or forfeiture period for the tenant's claim to renewal or for the landlord's action, and who raises it?
Does the tenant's right to renewal arise only after a minimum period of occupation?
What documents must be attached: the lease, the notice to quit, the bailiff's record, the commercial register extract?
What does the absence of notice to quit cost: tacit renewal, or nullity of the eviction?
Does the parties' contract validly depart from the legal period or form of notice?
What is the effect of the tenant's death, bankruptcy or sale of the business on the lease?
checklist.note: Death of the tenant: no text in articles 169 to 202 (k72).

checklist.item: What accessory requests may be added: rent arrears, damages, costs, provisional execution, penalty payment?
checklist.note: General accessory requests (interest, costs, penalty payment) are in the accessory-requests module.

checklist.item: The store notes on articles 187 مكرر and 187 مكرر 1 that the temporal start is unsettled (no national commencement date; Civil Code article 4 gives a per-locality rule): from which date does the wording apply, and what does that change for this unit?
checklist.note: The record takes 9 February 2005 (the issue date of the store's page) as the edge of the old regime and warns on leases made up to 10 March 2005 (n3); the per-locality reading is kept in o1.

checklist.item: The store notes on Civil Code articles 467 مكرر and 469 مكرر 1 that only the current text snapshot is held and commencement dates are deferred: does that affect the look-alike note?
checklist.note: The two articles serve only the look-alike note n8, which produces no effect; the date from which their 2007 wording applies changes nothing in this module.

checklist.item: The store notes on Civil Code article 3 that the Civil Code's inventory and amendment-chain certification are incomplete: from which date does the wording apply, and what does that change for this unit?
checklist.note: The note raises no later wording or start date; the article is the original 1975 text and serves only as the counting basis of d2 (Gregorian calendar), as in the periods module.

checklist.item: The store notes on Civil Code article 4 that its paragraph division differs from the French and that it sets no uniform national commencement date: what does that change for this unit?
checklist.note: It confirms that the start of 187 مكرر is per locality; hence boundary n3 and open point o1. The article's own wording dates from 1975.

checklist.item: The store notes on CPCA article 531 that Law 22-13 sets no calendar commencement and defers the new jurisdiction rules to the installation of the new courts: from which date does the wording apply, and what does that change for this unit?
checklist.note: Before the new courts were installed, the older wording (commercial section for commercial disputes, subject to article 32) governs; both wordings give the commercial section commercial disputes, so the interpretive section rule is unchanged.

checklist.item: The text of Law 05-02 itself (its article on publication and entry into force) and the former Code of Civil Procedure article 26 cited by Commercial Code 195 ¶2.
checklist.note: Searched the store's text views (commercial-code, civil-code, cpca): only the Commercial Code articles amended by Law 05-02 are held, not the law's own articles; the former Code of Civil Procedure is not in the store.

checklist.item: Management lease of the business (gerance libre), the title that follows article 202.
checklist.note: The article store ends this title at article 202; the articles on management leases are not in it (o10, grade D).

checklist.item: Death of the tenant and its effect on the lease.
checklist.note: Searched articles 169 to 202; none deals with it.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Commercial Code 170 ¶1 (the lead-in of the list of extensions).
checklist.note: 170 ¶1 only introduces the list whose items are cited as b4 and b5; it carries no rule of its own.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Commercial Code 175 ¶3 (renewal after a withdrawn refusal runs from the notice of acceptance).
checklist.note: Cited as b72: its first words name the notice to quit as one of the two ways the lessor notifies his refusal, which brings a lessee's attack on the notice under d1 (197); the start date of the renewal is not read by any item.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Commercial Code 188 ¶3 (rent increase when the sub-rent exceeds the main rent).
checklist.note: A rule on the amount of rent in an authorised sublease; no item of the module reads it.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Commercial Code 192 ¶1 (rent revision allowed subject to article 193).
checklist.note: The right to revise and its conditions are carried by b43 to b46 and exit x1; ¶1 adds only the reference to 193, cited as b46.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Commercial Code 193 ¶3 (the lessee's investments are not counted in the rental value).
checklist.note: A valuation element for the judge fixing the rent; no item of the module reads it.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Commercial Code 197 ¶5 (judgments in last resort may go to the Supreme Council).
checklist.note: A remedy after judgment; it does not bear on the petition (see o9 on the old references).

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Civil Code 469 مكرر 1 ¶2 (the Civil Code lessee may end the lease early for family or professional reasons).
checklist.note: It concerns leases under the Civil Code, outside this module's scope; the look-alike note n8 cites ¶1 only.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Civil Code 2 ¶1 (laws do not apply retroactively).
checklist.note: The special transitional rule of 187 مكرر 1 (b39) governs the regime of pre-publication leases; the general rule adds nothing the record uses.

checklist.item: Neighbour flag: Civil Code 321 ¶2 (limitation may be raised at any stage, even on appeal).
checklist.note: It concerns when the defendant may plead limitation, not the petition; d2 already says the court does not raise it of its own motion.

New-regime lease not in official form: warn.

Lease made in the days after the amending law's publication: the regime is flagged.

Old-regime lessee sues a few days after the three months: warn (inside the band).
Old-regime lessee sues long after the three months: warn (an interpretive period never blocks).
Old-regime lessee, date of the refusal unknown: ask.
Old-regime lessee who did not operate the business for the required period: warn.

Two-year limitation: a few days after the last day, warn.
Two-year limitation: long expired, a limitation still only warns.
Refusal without compensation for breach, warning given: none.
Refusal without compensation for breach, no valid warning: warn.
Refusal without compensation for breach, warning unknown: ask.
Dispute only on the rent of an accepted renewal: exit to the president of the court.
Renewal request left unanswered for three months: warn (the request itself valid, 174 ¶3; slot added by the verifier, atk-2).
Not a commercial lease: nothing of this module fires.
Commercial lease, eviction requested, contract date unknown: ask for it.
New-regime lease (2012), official, term ended: no notice needed, clean.
Old-regime lease (1999), lessee sues for compensation, refusal served 1 March 2024, petition well inside three months.
Old-regime lease: summons a few days after the three months from the refusal.
Old-regime lease: summons months after the three months from the refusal.
Old-regime lease: lessor asks eviction and no valid notice to quit was served.
Old-regime lease: lessor asks eviction, the notice is unknown.
Near miss: lease of a dwelling, not a commercial lease (corrected: the gated boundaries stay silent).
New-regime lease made in 2010 but not in official form.
Lease made on 20 February 2005, just after publication: regime unsettled.
Two-year limitation: right arose long ago.
Two-year limitation: a few days before the last day.
Two-year limitation: far inside.
Old-regime lessee claims compensation; no notice to quit and no valid renewal request.
Old-regime renewal request served; the lessor's three months still running.
Breach relied on to refuse without compensation, warning not valid.
Temporary administrative permit: outside the commercial-lease rules (now a boundary, not an exit).
Nothing known: the rules ask (no eviction request, so no notice step).
x61: new-regime lease stipulating a notice, eviction sought: p1 (173) does not apply; the stipulation boundary warns.
x52: the lessor, not the lessee, sues after a refusal: the 197 period does not apply.
x54: a 197 claim with the refusal date unknown: the 198 limitation stays silent, the 197 period asks.
x56: two-year limitation, petition on the last day under civil-code 314 counting: warn.
x48: lessee offered substitute premises sues long after three months from the refusal: the 197 period (reached through 178 ¶4) warns.
x49: priority right in issue, the lessee's notice was not given in time: warn.
x49: priority right in issue, notice given in time: none.
x95: an emphyteutic lease: warn.
x98: the business owner is not registered: warn.
Boundary case bc26: premises of a commune: the court is to be checked.
x50: the lessor's three months are not a filing deadline: an unanswered valid request is a boundary (n4), not a late petition.
adv-1: old-regime lessee sues before the commercial section; the section message now tells of the compulsory mediation of cpca 534 (the section stays commercial, d1 unaffected).
adv-2: the lessor is a commune: the exit to the administrative court (cpca 800) warns beside n15.
adv-3: old-regime lessee contests a refusal the lessor maintains: no accepted or deemed renewal, so request r9 (order renewal) is no longer offered; d1 runs, x1 and n4 silent.
adv-4: old-regime lessor evicts on a breach after a valid warning: the steps are done, and the eviction request offered is r13 (without compensation), not r2.
adv-5 and c-4: old-regime lessee asks to annul the notice to quit long after three months from its service: the 197 period (175 ¶3: the notice is a refusal) warns.
adv-6, c-1 and c-2: a lease in several periods ended at the end of a period, notice served less than six months before the end of that period: the notice does not conform, p1 warns.
adv-8: two years of operation complete only at the petition, not at the end of the lease (172 ¶4): the slot is no, n5 warns.
atk-2: renewal request without the required wording (void, 174 ¶3) left unanswered: no deemed acceptance, n4 silent.
atk-5: a lessee with a legitimate reason for a gap in operation answers yes (172 ¶2): n5 silent.
atk-6: cessation of operation without a serious and legitimate reason relied on, warning not valid: p2 warns.
atk-10: a 2010 deed that renews a 1995 lease: n13 warns that the renewal stays under the old law.
atk-11 and c-23: rent revision sought after a request that did not state the rent: p6 warns.
atk-11: rent revision sought, the request unknown: p6 asks.
atk-12: the losing owner's fifteen days (b54, from finality or from the appeal judgment) are not a filing deadline: a lessee's claim inside the 197 period stays clean.
atk-13, c-10 and c-11: lessee contests a take-back of the dwelling part (182 ¶3-¶4 bars, 182 ¶7 legitimate reason and proportional compensation now in the statements): d1 runs as for any refusal.
atk-14: premises leased to a commune for municipal services with the owner's consent: within the provisions (b4), the commune being party, x2 and n15 warn.
c-5: lessee offered substitute premises claims the 178 ¶3 compensation inside three months of the refusal: d1 silent (r10 now rests on 178 ¶3 too).
c-6 and c-7: dispute only on the terms of the new lease of substitute premises or under the priority right: x1 sends it to the president (178 ¶5, 179 ¶2).
c-8: priority right in issue, the lessee's notice given in time; damages for the owner's breach (179 ¶4, r14) may be asked: p5 silent.
